source: DungeonEncounter.db2, read as CSV from wago.tools. DungeonEncounter.ID is the number a Forever ENCOUNTER_START line carries, and Name_lang is the boss unit's own name, which is what a health_pct phase trigger matches against.
note: The Journal tables (JournalEncounter, JournalInstance) are not shipped by any Classic-lineage client, including this one; DungeonEncounter is the table the Classic client actually keys ENCOUNTER_START on. Every id below was read from the Forever beta client itself, not from Classic Era, so no fallback was needed.

instances.name: Molten Core
instances.opens: in the client at launch; the roadmap's Dec 9 unlock names Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia, not Molten Core

not_a_boss.name: The Molten Core
not_a_boss.why: the instance-clear entry, not a pull

instances.name: development fixtures
instances.opens: never: these are not Forever encounters
instances.note: The three tables the engine was built against before any Forever id was known. 9001 is the sample log's invented encounter; 2360 and 2363 are Shadowlands ids used as stand-ins. They stay until a Forever log replaces them, and are listed here so the id check does not have to make an exception.

no_client_rows_yet.note: Named as launch or December content by research/01-official-facts.md, but carrying no DungeonEncounter row in the 1.60.1.69893 beta client. The beta's level cap is 30, so the higher dungeons and both new raids are not in it yet. These get tables when a later build or a real log gives their ids.
